content:
We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (template_id 20810) to the given molecule (initial_molecule). The template search result gave mapped_rxn and template_id. We need to apply the template to the molecule to get precursors.

We have tool apply_template. Input: molecule_smiles (the target molecule) and template_id.

Let's call apply_template with given SMILES and template_id 20810.
